description:
Add ANOTHER independent Odoo instance to a box that ALREADY has Odoo installed
    (its own domain, database, port pair, systemd unit, data_dir and nginx site) -
    sharing the same Odoo binary + PostgreSQL. For hosting several small clients /
    sites on one server. `plan` describes the NEW instance (domain, db_name, apps,
    tls_mode); `slug` names its files/unit (default: the db_name). The port offset is
    auto-picked from the first free slot (override with `index`). Each instance needs
    its OWN secrets file - pass `secrets_path` (default: secrets_<slug>.json) so the
    admin/master passwords don't collide with the primary's. dry_run shows the exact
    files + chosen ports; confirm builds it. Additive: never touches other instances.
    On confirm this also runs the instance as its OWN systemd service (`odoo-<slug>`,
    enabled → survives reboot) and installs its OWN verified nightly backup (separate
    systemd timer, its own filestore, staggered time) so the extra instance is as
    complete as a full deploy - not a second-class citizen.
name: instance_add
